# Code of conduct

This project is for people who want to understand the US blockade of Cuba and do something about it. They come from different political traditions and different countries, and everyone who arrives in good faith is welcome here, including people who have never opened an issue before.

## What we ask of everyone

- Disagree with ideas and leave the person alone. Strong views about the blockade are expected, and we ask you to hold them with courtesy.
- Say where a fact comes from. This is a sourcing project, so link the page you read.
- Assume the other person means well until they show otherwise, and ask a question before you correct.
- Help newcomers. Everyone here started by not knowing how it works.
- Keep issues and pull requests on the site, its content and its code.

## What we do not accept

- Harassment, insults, slurs, threats and unwanted sexual attention.
- Contempt for people because of their race, nationality, religion, gender, sexuality, disability, age or class. Criticise policies, laws and governments as hard as the sources allow, and leave out hatred of Cubans, Americans or anyone else for who they are.
- Publishing private information about anyone, including officials. Only contact details that the person or office has published for the public belong in this project.
- Knowingly spreading a false claim, or inventing a source.
- Spam, advertising, and fundraising for anything we have not checked.

## Where this applies

In this repository (issues, pull requests, comments and reviews) and anywhere else someone speaks for the project.

## What happens when someone breaks it

The maintainer, Timothy Brits (GitHub: mooship), looks after the project and decides what to do. A first slip usually gets a friendly word. Serious or repeated problems get a comment removed, an issue closed, or a person blocked from the repository.

To report a problem, email cubaactiondesk@icloud.com, or use GitHub's "Report content" on the comment. We keep the identity of the person who reports private. If you think we got a decision wrong, reply to the message and we will look again.
